assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide internal-page hero background for a premium Korean general B2B company website. Primary request: Create an original editorial photograph representing a credible modern company and its people at work. Scene/backdrop: bright contemporary Korean office with architectural glass, white walls, pale stone and restrained navy details. Subject: a small diverse Korean business team walking through the space while discussing work naturally; candid, professional, no posing. Style/medium: high-end natural corporate photography with realistic skin, materials and daylight. Composition/framing: very wide 16:9 landscape, subjects concentrated in the right half, calm architectural negative space on the left for page title, medium-wide camera distance, clean horizontal lines. Lighting/mood: soft daylight, confident, calm and premium. Color palette: white, cool gray, ink navy, very restrained blue. Constraints: no visible logos, no readable text, no signage, no watermark, no handshake, no staged smiles, no fake awards or statistics, no gradients, no colored graphical overlays.
